name: Abū al-Faḍl al-ʿAbbās ibn al-Faraj al-Riyāshī
summary: Basran grammarian and lexicographer, student of al-Aṣmaʿī, who read al-Kitāb with al-Māzinī and was killed when the Zanj took Basra.
bio: Al-Riyāshī learnt the language from al-Aṣmaʿī and read Sībawayh's book with al-Māzinī; al-Zubaydī places him in the seventh Basran generation and transmits several reports about Sībawayh through him, among them that Sībawayh was firm in the Sunna. Al-Mubarrad and Ibn Durayd learnt from him.
He was killed in 257/871 when the rebels of the Zanj sacked Basra, by the reports in the mosque at prayer.

sources.title: al-Zubaydī, Ṭabaqāt al-naḥwiyyīn wa-l-lughawiyyīn, entry 32 (Arabic text, OpenITI)
